commerceOrders.periodTotal: Total of this page (cancelled and refunded orders excluded):
commerceOrders.exportError: The orders could not be exported.

commerceVariantPicker.placeholder: Type a product name or SKU…

commerceManualOrder.description: For a phone order, a trade-show sale or a correction. Nothing is created if the order is refused.
commerceManualOrder.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address, such as customer@example.com.
commerceManualOrder.quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
commerceManualOrder.mixedCurrencies: All items of an order must use the same currency.
commerceManualOrder.countryHint: Decides the taxes and the delivery methods offered.
commerceManualOrder.addressRequired: Complete the address (line 1, postal code and city) or clear it.
commerceManualOrder.fixErrors: Fix the flagged fields to create the order.
commerceManualOrder.outOfStockLine: Not enough stock for “{{name}}”: {{requested}} requested, {{available}} available.
commerceManualOrder.couponRefused: This promo code cannot be applied to this order.
commerceManualOrder.createError: The order could not be created.

commerceOrderDetail.eventDunningSuspended: Subscription suspended after repeated failed payments
commerceOrderDetail.eventProration: Prorated charge for a plan change
commerceOrderDetail.recordPaymentBody: The customer paid {{amount}} by a means the shop cannot see (transfer, cash, cheque, card terminal). The order will become “Paid”.
commerceOrderDetail.paymentRecorded: The payment was recorded: the order is paid.
commerceOrderDetail.paymentNoteHint: Optional, for example the transfer reference.
commerceOrderDetail.cancelBody: The order will be cancelled and the reserved stock put back on sale. This cannot be undone: a cancelled order cannot be reopened.
commerceOrderDetail.cancelPaidBody: This order is already paid. Cancelling puts the stock back on sale but does not refund the customer: to give the money back, use “Refund”. Cancelling cannot be undone.
commerceOrderDetail.shipBody: The order will become “Shipped” without a tracking number. If you have one, enter it in the “Shipment tracking” card instead: the customer is notified with the tracking link. This cannot be undone.
commerceOrderDetail.shippedDone: The order is marked as shipped.
commerceOrderDetail.deliverBody: The parcel reached the customer. This cannot be undone: only a refund can follow.
commerceOrderDetail.deliveredDone: The order is marked as delivered.
commerceOrderDetail.invoiceConfirmBody: An invoice gets a final number that can be neither reused nor deleted. Correcting an invoice means issuing a credit note. Check the preview first.
commerceOrderDetail.invoiceNotConfigured: To issue invoices, first fill in the seller's identity (legal name, address).
commerceOrderDetail.invoiceNone: No invoice for a cancelled or refunded order.
commerceOrderDetail.invoicePreviewError: The invoice could not be previewed.
commerceOrderDetail.refundBody: Refundable amount: {{max}}. A partial refund is possible.
commerceOrderDetail.refundAmountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
commerceOrderDetail.refundTooMuch: This amount exceeds what is left to refund ({{max}}).
commerceOrderDetail.refundReasonRequired: Give the reason: it is required for a refund.
commerceOrderDetail.trackingUrlHint: Optional. A full web address starting with http:// or https://.
commerceOrderDetail.trackingUrlInvalid: That is not a valid web address: it must start with http:// or https://.
commerceOrderDetail.settleError: The payment could not be recorded.

commerceCoupons.heading: Coupons
commerceCoupons.codeHint: Short and easy to type: letters, digits, hyphens, such as “SPRING25”. The code cannot be changed afterwards.
commerceCoupons.codeFixedHint: A coupon's code cannot be changed: it is already printed or sent.
commerceCoupons.codeInvalid: A code may only contain unaccented letters, digits, hyphens and underscores (no spaces or “%”).
commerceCoupons.codeTooLong: The code is too long (64 characters at most).
commerceCoupons.kindLockedHint: This coupon has already been used: its type can no longer change.
commerceCoupons.percentInvalid: Enter a percentage above 0 and at most 100 (a comma is fine).
commerceCoupons.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero (a comma is fine).
commerceCoupons.minSubtotalHint: Optional. The code only applies from this amount.
commerceCoupons.endsAtHint: This day included. Leave empty for no expiry.
commerceCoupons.windowInvalid: The end date must be after the start date.
commerceCoupons.maxRedemptionsPerCustomerHint: Leave empty for no per-customer limit.
commerceCoupons.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1, or leave empty.
commerceCoupons.restrictedProductIdsHint: Optional. Search a product by name; with none chosen, the code applies to every product.
commerceCoupons.deactivateBody: The code {{code}} will stop working at checkout immediately. You can reactivate it at any time.
commerceCoupons.deleteBody: The coupon {{code}}, never used, will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
commerceCoupons.fixErrors: Fix the flagged fields to save the coupon.
commerceCoupons.saveError: The coupon could not be saved.
commerceCoupons.deleteError: The coupon could not be deleted.
commerceCoupons.updateError: The coupon could not be changed.
commerceCoupons.createError: The coupon could not be created.

commerceSubscriptions.metricsMrrHint: Active subscriptions, normalised to a month
commerceSubscriptions.endBody: {{name}}'s subscription will end: no more charges will be made. This cannot be undone, a new subscription would have to be created to resume.
commerceSubscriptions.pauseBody: {{name}}'s subscription will not be billed while paused. When resumed, the planned next charge date is kept.
commerceSubscriptions.emptyHelp: A subscription opens when a paid order contains a recurring product (set the recurrence on the variant), or with “New subscription”.
commerceSubscriptions.cancelError: The subscription could not be ended.

commerceSubscriptionDetail.heading: {{name}}'s subscription
commerceSubscriptionDetail.dateBody: Moves the next charge. Later charges follow this new date.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.datePast: The date must be today or later.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.dateSaved: The next charge date was changed.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.dateError: The date could not be changed.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.currencyMismatch: This product is not in {{currency}}: the currency cannot change during a subscription.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.changePlanIntro: Choose the new plan: the amount due for the rest of the period is shown before anything is charged.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.previewCharge: If you confirm, {{amount}} will be charged now for the rest of the current period.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.previewCredit: If you confirm, the customer is owed a {{amount}} credit for the rest of the period. It is not refunded automatically: handle it separately.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.previewNothing: If you confirm, nothing is due for the rest of the period.
commerceSubscriptionDetail.changePlanError: The plan could not be changed.

commerceNewSubscription.heading: New subscription
commerceNewSubscription.description: For a subscription agreed outside the site. Subscriptions coming from a paid order open on their own.
commerceNewSubscription.everyInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
commerceNewSubscription.priceHint: Defaults to the product's price. The customer keeps it even if the catalogue changes.
commerceNewSubscription.startAtHint: Today means the first charge happens right away.
commerceNewSubscription.startRequired: Pick the date of the first charge.
commerceNewSubscription.countryHint: Decides the taxes applied on each charge.
commerceNewSubscription.createError: The subscription could not be created.

commerceTax.categoryHint: The category chosen on each product variant.
commerceTax.newCategoryHint: For example “reduced” or “books”. It will then be offered everywhere.
commerceTax.nameRequired: Give this rule a name, such as “France VAT 20%”.
commerceTax.rateInvalid: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (a comma is fine, such as 5,5).
commerceTax.countryHint: “Everywhere” applies to any country without a more specific rule.
commerceTax.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount (a comma is fine).
commerceTax.noRuleApplied: No rule matches this country and category: this sale would not be taxed.
commerceTax.fixErrors: Fix the flagged fields to save the rule.
commerceTax.saveError: The tax rule could not be saved.
commerceTax.deleteBody: The rule “{{name}}” will be deleted for good. Matching sales will no longer be taxed, or taxed by a less specific rule. Orders already placed do not change.

commerceShipping.description: The delivery methods offered at checkout, by country. The most specific (country, then region) wins.
commerceShipping.offered: Offer this delivery method to customers
commerceShipping.labelRequired: Give this delivery method a name, such as “Standard delivery”.

kindHint.flat: The same price for every order.
kindHint.by_weight: A base price plus a price per kilo: each variant's weight is set on its product page.
kindHint.pickup: The customer collects the order: no cost.

commerceShipping.countryHint: “All countries” applies to any destination without a more specific method.
commerceShipping.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount (a comma is fine).
commerceShipping.perKgHint: Optional. Added for each started kilo.
commerceShipping.freeOverHint: Optional. Basket amount from which delivery is free.
commerceShipping.weightInvalid: Enter a weight in grams (a whole number).
commerceShipping.simulatorHint: Asks the checkout's own calculation: you see the methods a customer would get for this order.
commerceShipping.noQuotes: No delivery method serves this destination.
commerceShipping.fixErrors: Fix the flagged fields to save this delivery method.
commerceShipping.saveError: The delivery method could not be saved.
commerceShipping.deleteBody: “{{label}}” will no longer be offered at checkout. Orders already placed do not change. This cannot be undone.
commerceShipping.empty: No delivery method yet: customers cannot choose delivery until one is added.

commercePayment.description: The payment methods offered at checkout and their state. Keys are never shown: you only see whether they are present.
commercePayment.testModeOnHint: No real money moves. To take real payments, switch the shop to production mode in the server configuration (“payment” section), then restart it.
commercePayment.providersHint: The payment methods available on this server. Keys and secrets are set in the server configuration, never from the admin.
commercePayment.settlesOffline: The customer pays outside the site; you record the payment yourself on the order once the money arrives.
commercePayment.settlesOnline: The payment is confirmed automatically by the provider.

testResult.ok: Connection successful: the provider answers with these credentials.
testResult.not_configured: No credentials are configured for this payment method on this server: there is nothing to test.
testResult.unreachable: The provider is unreachable or refuses these credentials.
testResult.error: The test failed. Check the server configuration.

commercePayment.webhookNotWired: Paste this address into your payment provider's dashboard: this is how it tells the shop an order is paid.

commerceSettings.description: Currency, prices, countries served, legal pages and invoices of the shop. Each card has its own “Save” button.
commerceSettings.currencyHint: The currency of catalogue prices and new orders.
commerceSettings.currencyInvalid: Pick a currency from the list.
commerceSettings.countriesHint: Pick the countries you deliver to.
commerceSettings.allCountries: No country chosen: the shop sells to every country.
commerceSettings.minOrderHint: Minimum basket amount, such as {{example}}. Leave empty for no minimum.
commerceSettings.minOrderInvalid: Enter a valid amount (a comma is fine), such as 5.00.
commerceSettings.pathInvalid: The path must start with “/”, such as /terms.
commerceSettings.pageMissing: Careful: the address “{{path}}” does not answer right now. The setting is saved, but check the page is published.
commerceSettings.sellerHint: Printed on every invoice and credit note. Until the name and address are filled in, no invoice can be issued.
commerceSettings.sellerNameRequired: Fill in the legal name too.
commerceSettings.sellerAddressHint: One line per address line: street, postal code and city, country.
commerceSettings.sellerTaxIdHint: For example FR12 345678901 or a company number. Printed as is.
commerceSettings.sellerFooterHint: Optional: share capital, registration, legal notices…
commerceSettings.invoiceHint: How invoices look: numbering, language and payment terms. A change applies to the next invoice issued.
commerceSettings.seriesInvalid: The prefix may only contain letters, digits and hyphens.
commerceSettings.invoicePreviewHint: Generates a real PDF from an existing order, to see how your settings look. Nothing is saved and no invoice number is used.
commerceSettings.invoicePreviewNoOrders: No order yet: the preview needs an existing order.
commerceSettings.invoicePreviewError: The invoice could not be previewed. Check that the seller identity is filled in.
commerceSettings.saveError: These settings could not be saved.

currency.label: Shop currency
currency.help: Three-letter ISO code, such as EUR.

invoiceLanguage.label: Invoice language
invoiceLanguage.help: French or English: the language of the labels printed on the invoice.

sellerFooter.label: Invoice footer
sellerFooter.help: Legal notices printed at the bottom of each invoice.

commerceCustomerDetail.anonymizeConfirm: The customer's e-mail and name will be erased for good. Their orders and invoices keep their own copy (accounting requirement). This cannot be undone.

commerceProducts.importExportDescription: Export the catalogue, or import a CSV file: each line is a variant (one SKU). Columns are matched by name, in any order. Download the sample file to start from an example.
commerceProducts.newIntro: Name the product. You will then add its variants (size, colour…) with their prices and stock: without a variant, a product cannot be sold.
commerceProducts.handleHint: Used in web addresses and in the admin: unaccented lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as “wool-scarf”.
commerceProducts.handleEditHint: Changing it changes the web address of the product page.
commerceProducts.handleInvalid: Use only unaccented lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as “wool-scarf”.
commerceProducts.fixErrors: Fix the flagged fields to continue.
commerceProducts.editIntro: “Save” keeps the title, handle and status. Images, linked content and categories are saved as soon as you change them.
commerceProducts.archiveBody: “{{title}}” will no longer be offered for sale, but stays in the catalogue with its orders. You can reactivate it at any time.
commerceProducts.variantsIntro: Each variant is a sellable item with its own SKU, price and stock.
commerceProducts.skuHint: The item's unique reference, such as “TSH-BLUE-M”.
commerceProducts.variantTitleRequired: Name the variant, such as “Size M”.
commerceProducts.priceInvalid: Enter a valid price, zero or more (a comma is fine), such as 19.90.
commerceProducts.stockInvalid: Enter a whole stock number, zero or more.
commerceProducts.weightInvalid: Enter a weight in grams (a whole number) or leave empty.
commerceProducts.recurringToggle: Sell this variant as a subscription
commerceProducts.recurringHint: When an order containing this variant is paid, a subscription opens automatically for the customer.
commerceProducts.lowStockHint: Optional: alert when stock falls to this level.
commerceProducts.comparePriceHint: Optional: the former price, shown struck through during a sale.
commerceProducts.comparePriceInvalid: The compare-at price is not a valid amount (a comma is fine).
commerceProducts.comparePriceTooLow: The compare-at price must be higher than the selling price.
commerceProducts.saleDatesOrder: The sale must end after it starts.
commerceProducts.dimensionInvalid: Enter a positive whole number, or leave empty.
commerceProducts.variantSaveError: The variant could not be saved.
commerceProducts.variantDeleteError: The variant could not be deleted.
commerceProducts.removeVariantBody: The variant “{{title}}” will be deleted for good, with its stock history. Orders already placed keep their copy. This cannot be undone.
commerceProducts.noVariant: No variant yet: add one to be able to sell this product.
commerceProducts.imagesHint: The first image is the cover shown in the product list. Drag and drop to reorder. Images are saved as soon as you change them.

commerceCsv.duplicateSku: this SKU appears several times in the file: only the last line will be applied

issue.HEADER_MISSING: required columns are missing from the first row: {{value}}.
issue.MISSING_FIELD: the handle, title, SKU or variant name is missing.
issue.STOCK_INVALID: the stock “{{value}}” is not a valid whole number.
issue.NUMBER_INVALID: a stock threshold or a dimension is not a whole number.
issue.COMPARE_PRICE_INVALID: the compare-at price “{{value}}” is not valid.
issue.COMPARE_PRICE_TOO_LOW: the compare-at price must be higher than the price.
issue.DATE_INVALID: a sale date is not valid.
issue.SALE_DATES_ORDER: the sale must end after it starts.
issue.ROW_LIMIT: only the first {{max}} lines were read, the rest of the file is ignored.
issue.INTERNAL: this line could not be saved.
